title: Case 247: Nina Puganova, Irina Trasyn & Anastasia Mikhailova

sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血也被放干了。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 的全新系列，现已上线，各大播客平台皆可收听。

sentences.en: Welcome to Tangerine's refreshingly simple tech tips.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到 Tangerine 简单实用的科技小贴士。

sentences.en: If your Wi-Fi is acting more suspicious than a dodgy alibi, start investigating by checking your Wi-Fi router's lights.
sentences.zh: 如果你的 Wi-Fi 表现得比不可靠的不在场证明还要可疑，请首先检查 Wi-Fi 路由器上的指示灯来排查问题。

sentences.en: If they're flashing in a way you don't usually see, it could mean another device is using too much internet bandwidth.
sentences.zh: 如果它们的闪烁方式不同寻常，可能意味着有其他设备占用了太多网络带宽。

sentences.en: A quick reset can help your Wi-Fi router start its day again, and declutter your network, like a quick power nap.
sentences.zh: 快速重启可以帮助你的 Wi-Fi 路由器重新开始运作并清理网络，就像打了个快盹一样。

sentences.en: When your internet gives you lemons, get Tangerine.
sentences.zh: 当生活给你苦果时，就选 Tangerine。

sentences.en: Internet that works without the mysteries.
sentences.zh: 简单靠谱、拒绝迷茫的网络服务。

sentences.en: Check out tangerine.com.au for more info.
sentences.zh: 访问 tangerine.com.au 了解更多信息。

sentences.en: Our episodes deal with serious and often distressing incidents.
sentences.zh: 我们的节目涉及严肃且往往令人痛心的事件。

sentences.en: If you feel at any time you need support, please contact your local crisis centre.
sentences.zh: 如果您在任何时候感到需要支持，请联系您当地的危机干预中心。

sentences.en: For suggested phone numbers for confidential support, please see the show notes for this episode on your app or on our website.
sentences.zh: 有关保密支持的建议电话号码，请查看您应用内或我们网站上的本期节目说明。

sentences.en: This episode was originally released on Casefile's Patreon, Apple Premium, and Spotify Premium feeds as an early bonus for our paid subscribers.
sentences.zh: 本期节目最初发布在 Casefile 的 Patreon、Apple Premium 和 Spotify Premium 频道上，作为给付费订阅者的早期福利。

sentences.en: These episodes are designed to be slightly shorter, allowing us to cover a broader range of cases.
sentences.zh: 这些节目的设计略微缩短，使我们能够涵盖更广泛的案件。

sentences.en: To receive these episodes early and ad-free, you can support Casefile on your preferred platform.
sentences.zh: 要提前收听这些无广告的节目，您可以在您首选的平台上支持 Casefile。

sentences.en: As it neared six o'clock on an autumn morning in 1980,
sentences.zh: 那是1980年一个秋日早晨近六点时，

sentences.en: Theodosius Glukarev was jolted awake by the sound of his apartment's doorbell.
sentences.zh: 狄奥多修斯·格卢卡列夫被公寓的门铃声惊醒。
zh_words: 狄奥多修斯·格卢卡列夫

sentences.en: He rose from bed and headed to the door.
sentences.zh: 他从床上起来，朝门口走去。

sentences.en: No one was there.
sentences.zh: 外面没有人。

sentences.en: He poked his head into the hallway, only to find the area empty and quiet.
sentences.zh: 他探头朝走廊望去，发现四周空无一人且一片寂静。

sentences.en: Theodosius looked down and noticed a dark leather briefcase on the ground in front of him.
sentences.zh: 狄奥多修斯低头一看，发现脚边放着一个黑色皮质公文包。

sentences.en: Curious, Theodosius laid it on its side, unclasped its latches, and opened it up.
sentences.zh: 出于好奇，狄奥多修斯把它放倒，解开搭扣，打开了它。

sentences.en: Wedged inside and wrapped in cloth was the head of a woman.
sentences.zh: 里面塞着一块用布包裹的东西，是一个女人的头颅。

sentences.en: Theodosius staggered back inside his apartment and immediately phoned the police.
sentences.zh: 狄奥多修斯踉跄着退回公寓，立刻报了警。

sentences.en: Officers arrived at the large, nine-storey building where Theodosius lived with his wife and young daughter.
sentences.zh: 警察赶到了这座九层的大楼，狄奥多修斯和他的妻子及年幼的女儿就住在这里。

sentences.en: Their apartment was just south of Kishinev, the Russian-named capital of Moldova, which at the time was part of the Soviet Union.
sentences.zh: 他们的公寓位于基希讷夫正南方，基希讷夫是摩尔多瓦带有俄语名称的首都，当时是苏联的一部分。

sentences.en: The officers inspected the briefcase that had been left at Theodosius' door.
sentences.zh: 警察检查了遗留在狄奥多修斯门前的公文包。

sentences.en: The decapitated head belonged to a brown-haired woman whose eyes had been gouged out.
sentences.zh: 这个被斩首的头颅属于一名棕发女子，她的眼睛被挖掉了。

sentences.en: Theodosius was adamant that he didn't recognise the woman and there was nothing else inside the briefcase that hinted at her identity.
sentences.zh: 狄奥多修斯坚称他不认识这个女人，公文包里也没有其他暗示她身份的东西。

sentences.en: However, there was a handwritten note.
sentences.zh: 不过，里面有一张手写便条。

sentences.en: Addressed to Theodosius and scrawled in block capital letters, the note read,
sentences.zh: 便条是写给狄奥多修斯的，上面用粗体大写字母潦草地写着：

sentences.en: Have you seen the gift?
sentences.zh: 你看到礼物了吗？

sentences.en: This is an example for you.
sentences.zh: 这是对你的一个教训。

sentences.en: Ready ten thousand rubles or your daughter will also be headless.
sentences.zh: 准备好一万卢布，否则你女儿也会身首异处。

sentences.en: In the evening you will come to the train station and bring money.
sentences.zh: 晚上你带着钱来火车站。

sentences.en: Extortion was rare in Soviet Moldova, let alone in such a brutal form.
sentences.zh: 敲诈勒索在苏属摩尔多瓦极为罕见，更不用说以如此残忍的形式了。

sentences.en: At the time, ten thousand rubles was a large amount of money, the equivalent of around fifty thousand US dollars in today's currency.
sentences.zh: 在当时，一万卢布是一大笔钱，相当于如今约五万美元的价值。

sentences.en: Theodosius, who worked as a truck driver for a local brewery, was adamant that he didn't have access to that kind of money.
sentences.zh: 狄奥多修斯当地一家啤酒厂的货车司机，坚称自己根本拿不出这笔钱。

sentences.en: Unable to produce the large ransom in such a short amount of time, it was impossible for him to meet the killer's demands.
sentences.zh: 由于无法在这么短的时间内凑出巨额赎金，他根本不可能满足凶手的要求。

sentences.en: Given that the killer knew where Theodosius lived and that he had a daughter, it was clear that they knew Theodosius in some capacity.
sentences.zh: 鉴于凶手知道狄奥多修斯住哪，而且他有个女儿，很显然凶手在某种程度上认识狄奥多修斯。

sentences.en: Yet, Theodosius couldn't think of anyone who would carry out such a gruesome act.
sentences.zh: 然而，狄奥多修斯怎么也想不出是谁会做出如此残忍的行径。

sentences.en: Suspicious that he was hiding something, police covertly surveilled Theodosius the following day.
sentences.zh: 由于怀疑他有所隐瞒，警方于次日对狄奥多修斯进行了暗中监视。

sentences.en: They discreetly tailed his truck as he drove from the brewery and onto the streets of Kishinev, where he eventually parked and entered a restaurant.
sentences.zh: 当他驾驶货车从啤酒厂驶入基希讷夫的街道时，他们隐蔽地尾随着他，最后他把车停下并走进了一家餐厅。

sentences.en: It was an expensive establishment, the kind of place the affluent might dine at only once or twice a year for special occasions.
sentences.zh: 那是一家高档场所，富人们一年到头也难得在特殊场合去上那么一两次。

sentences.en: Theodosius didn't stay long, certainly not enough time for him to eat.
sentences.zh: 狄奥多修斯没待多久，显然没有时间吃饭。

sentences.en: He soon returned to his truck and drove off.
sentences.zh: 他很快回到货车上驱车离开。

sentences.en: As the surveillance continued,
sentences.zh: 随着监视的继续，

sentences.en: Theodosius started behaving erratically.
sentences.zh: 狄奥多修斯开始表现得反常起来。

sentences.en: It seemed he realised that he was being followed.
sentences.zh: 似乎他意识到自己被跟踪了。

sentences.en: He took several abrupt turns and doubled back on his route before speeding through a red light.
sentences.zh: 他接连几个急转弯，在路线上折返，然后闯红灯疾驰而去。

sentences.en: Police managed to catch up with him a little while later, by which point Theodosius had resumed going about his business.
sentences.zh: 不久后警察设法追上了他，此时狄奥多修斯已经恢复了正常行事。

sentences.en: He entered a bakery and emerged with a cake in hand.
sentences.zh: 他走进一家面包店，手里拿著一个蛋糕出来。

sentences.en: He then walked to a nearby apartment building which was considered one of Kishinev's most prestigious addresses.
sentences.zh: 然后他走到附近的一栋公寓楼，那里被认为是基希讷夫最负盛名的地址之一。

sentences.en: Theodosius disappeared inside for some time before reappearing without the cake.
sentences.zh: 狄奥多修斯在里面消失了一会儿，出来时手里已经没有了蛋糕。

sentences.en: Later that day, he purchased a bouquet of flowers and visited another high-end apartment building on an adjacent street.
sentences.zh: 那天晚些时候，他买了一束花，去了相邻街道的另一栋高端公寓楼。

sentences.en: Once again, he stayed inside briefly before exiting empty-handed.
sentences.zh: 他再次在里面待了短暂的一会儿，然后空手出来。

sentences.en: He then made his way home.
sentences.zh: 接着他踏上了回家的路。

sentences.en: He admitted to driving erratically after realising he was being pursued, but explained this was because he thought he was being trailed by the killer.
sentences.zh: 他承认在意识到自己被追踪后开车行为反常，但解释说这是因为他以为自己被凶手跟踪了。

sentences.en: Police put it to Theodosius that his job as a truck driver was really just a front for some kind of black market trading.
sentences.zh: 警方质问狄奥多修斯，说他货车司机的职业其实只是某种黑市交易的掩护。

sentences.en: He denied being involved in anything illegal, but eventually confessed that his visits to the two apartments were for clandestine meetings.
sentences.zh: 他否认参与任何非法活动，但最终坦白他去那两间公寓是为了秘密幽会。

sentences.en: Theodosius had been calling in on his girlfriends.
sentences.zh: 狄奥多修斯一直在拜访他的女朋友们。

sentences.en: Neither of his girlfriends knew about the other, nor were they aware that Theodosius was married with a child.
sentences.zh: 他的两个女朋友都不知道彼此的存在，也不知道狄奥多修斯已婚并育有一子。

sentences.en: Although he wasn't a particularly remarkable or wealthy man,
sentences.zh: 尽管他并不是一个特别显眼或富有的人，

sentences.en: Theodosius was a serial womaniser who often bragged to his friends about his extramarital affairs.
sentences.zh: 狄奥多修斯却是个连续拈花惹草的花花公子，经常向朋友吹嘘自己的婚外情。

sentences.en: Investigators were satisfied that Theodosius wasn't part of any underworld scheming, but had been targeted for some other specific reason.
sentences.zh: 调查人员确信狄奥多修斯没有参与任何黑社会阴谋，而是出于其他某种特定原因被盯上了。

sentences.en: They considered the possibility that the severed head might have belonged to one of his girlfriends.
sentences.zh: 他们考虑了这样一种可能性：被割下的头颅可能属于他的某个女朋友。

sentences.en: Perhaps the woman's husband had found out about the affair and taken revenge.
sentences.zh: 也许是那个女人的丈夫发现了这段婚外情并进行了报复。

sentences.en: Theodosius claimed that his girlfriends were both alive and well, and it was quickly confirmed that he was telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 狄奥多修斯坚称他的两个女朋友都活得好好的，而且很快就证实他说的是实话。

sentences.en: Both of his girlfriends attended the police station for questioning, but neither recognised the face of the woman from the briefcase.
sentences.zh: 他的两个女朋友都去了警察局接受盘问，但谁也没有认出公文包里那个女人的脸。

sentences.en: This sent investigators back to square one.
sentences.zh: 这让调查人员回到了原点。

sentences.en: Unable to figure out why Theodosius was being extorted, they worked to identify the victim.
sentences.zh: 由于无法弄清狄奥多修斯为何遭到勒索，他们致力于确定受害者的身份。

sentences.en: Perhaps if they knew who she was, her connection to Theodosius would become clear.
sentences.zh: 也许只要知道她是谁，她与狄奥多修斯的关系就会明朗起来。

sentences.en: After exhausting all other avenues, investigators sought permission from their country's leadership to employ a tactic that had never been used in the Soviet Union before.
sentences.zh: 在用尽所有其他途径后，调查人员请求国家领导层批准采用一项在苏联从未使用的战术。

sentences.en: They asked to show a photograph of the woman's head on national television in the hope that someone would recognise her face.
sentences.zh: 他们请求在全国电视上播放该女性头部的照片，希望能有人认出她的脸。

sentences.en: Their request was granted.
sentences.zh: 他们的请求得到了批准。

sentences.en: With as much care as possible, the woman's face was cleaned to be presentable to the public.
sentences.zh: 为了能在公众面前呈现，工作人员尽可能小心翼翼地清洁了女子的脸。

sentences.en: Her hair was neatly combed down and pinned behind her head.
sentences.zh: 她的头发被整齐地梳理下来并在脑后别好。

sentences.en: Glass spheres were inserted into her empty eye sockets and her eyelids were closed over them.
sentences.zh: 她的空眼眶里塞进了玻璃球，眼睑闭合在上面。

sentences.en: A photograph was taken and broadcast on national television across Soviet Moldova.
sentences.zh: 拍下照片并在苏联摩尔多瓦全国范围内进行了电视转播。

sentences.en: Although a white scarf tied beneath her chin concealed her severed neck, it was obvious to most that she was deceased.
sentences.zh: 尽管系在她下巴底下的白色围巾遮住了她被割断的脖子，但大多数人还是一眼看出她已经去世了。

sentences.en: That night, seven-year-old Victor Thrasen sat in front of his family's television set, eyes glued to a rerun of a popular Soviet musical miniseries,
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，七岁的维克托·特拉斯恩坐在家里的电视机前，眼睛死死盯着一部广受欢迎的苏联音乐迷你剧的重播，

sentences.en: D'Artagnan and the Three Musketeers.
sentences.zh: 《三个火枪手》。

sentences.en: Victor lived with his mother and ailing grandmother in an apartment in Kishinev.
sentences.zh: 维克托和母亲以及生病的祖母住在基希讷夫的一套公寓里。

sentences.en: His grandmother was content to let Victor enjoy the swashbuckling action on screen as the young boy had recently been overcome with anxiety
sentences.zh: 他的祖母满足于让维克托欣赏屏幕上的刀光剑影，因为这名小男孩最近被焦虑情绪压得喘不过气来，

sentences.en: and the program provided a much-needed distraction.
sentences.zh: 而这个节目正好提供了急需的转移注意力的机会。

sentences.en: A few nights earlier, Victor's mother, Irina, had left home to catch up with a friend.
sentences.zh: 几天前的晚上，维克托的母亲伊莉娜离家去和一个朋友见面。

sentences.en: She said that she would only be gone for 30 minutes, but by the time Victor awoke the next morning, she still hadn't returned.
sentences.zh: 她说自己只离开30分钟，但当维克托第二天早晨醒来时，她依然没有回来。

sentences.en: Victor took himself to school and later made dinner for himself and his grandmother.
sentences.zh: 维克托自己去了学校，后来给自己和祖母做晚饭。

sentences.en: He kept this up all the while bombarding his grandmother with questions about his mother's whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 他一直这样坚持着，同时不断用母亲的下落质问祖母。

sentences.en: But she couldn't give him any answers.
sentences.zh: 但她什么也回答不上来。

sentences.en: Victor's concerns for Irina grew until he parked himself in front of the television one night for a mental reprieve.
sentences.zh: 维克托对伊莉娜的担忧日益加剧，直到有一天晚上他坐到电视机前寻求心理上的喘息。

sentences.en: All of a sudden,
sentences.zh: 突然，

sentences.en: D'Artagnan and the Three Musketeers was interrupted by a special news bulletin.
sentences.zh: 《三个火枪手》被一则特别新闻快报打断了。

sentences.en: A photograph of a woman appeared on screen.
sentences.zh: 屏幕上出现了一名女子的照片。

sentences.en: Victor immediately recognised the woman as his mother, Irina.
sentences.zh: 维克托一眼认出这个女人就是他的母亲伊莉娜。

sentences.en: He was confused as to why she was on television, but excited that he would finally see her again.
sentences.zh: 他搞不懂她为什么会出现在电视上，但又为终于能再次见到她而兴奋不已。

sentences.en: He wrote down the number on the screen and called it first thing the following morning.
sentences.zh: 他记下了屏幕上的号码，第二天一早便拨打了它。

sentences.en: Investigators could now identify the mutilated woman as Irina Trassen, but they still had no idea why she had been targeted.
sentences.zh: 调查人员现在可以确认这名遭受残害的女子是伊莉娜·特拉斯恩，但他们仍然不知道她为什么会成为目标。

sentences.en: Theodosius Glukarev claimed he didn't know Irina and there was no evidence to suggest the pair had ever crossed paths.
sentences.zh: 狄奥多修斯·格卢卡列夫声称他不认识伊莉娜，也没有证据表明两人曾有过交集。
zh_words: 狄奥多修斯·格卢卡列夫

sentences.en: As investigators tried to determine why Irina was murdered as part of an extortion plot against a stranger, they received a phone call.
sentences.zh: 正当调查人员试图弄清为什么伊莉娜会作为针对陌生人的勒索阴谋的一部分而被谋杀时，他们接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: Another package had just arrived at Theodosius' front door.
sentences.zh: 狄奥多修斯的家门口刚刚送达了另一个包裹。

sentences.en: The package wasn't in a briefcase this time, but wrapped in paper.
sentences.zh: 这次包裹没有装在公文包里，而是用纸包着的。

sentences.en: Again, it was accompanied by a handwritten note addressed to Theodosius in the same block capital letters as the firSt.
sentences.zh: 同样，里面也附有一张手写便条，收件人是狄奥多修斯，字迹和第一张一样，都是粗体大写字母。

sentences.en: This one read,
sentences.zh: 这封上面写着：

sentences.en: Forensic analysis confirmed it did not belong to Irina Trassen.
sentences.zh: 法医分析证实它不属于伊莉娜·特拉斯恩。

sentences.en: A second woman had been killed and once again the police were left with no clues as to this victim's identity.
sentences.zh: 第二名女性遇害了，警方再次对这名受害者的身份毫无头绪。

sentences.en: The note continued,
sentences.zh: 便条接着写道：

sentences.en: The note hadn't referred to Theodosius' daughter by her name, Oksana, but this was the second direct threat against her.
sentences.zh: 便条没有用狄奥多修斯女儿的名字奥克萨娜称呼她，但这是对她的第二次直接威胁。

sentences.en: Two days later,
sentences.zh: 两天后，

sentences.en: Oksana was making her way home from school.
sentences.zh: 奥克萨娜正放学回家。

sentences.en: Just as she reached the entrance to her family's apartment block, a man approached and offered her some candy.
sentences.zh: 就在她走到自家公寓楼入口时，一个男子走上前去递给她一些糖果。

sentences.en: All of a sudden, two other men who had been a short distance behind Oksana leapt into action.
sentences.zh: 突然，另外两名一直跟在奥克萨娜身后不远处的男子采取了行动。

sentences.en: They ran up to the man, grabbed him and wrestled him to the ground.
sentences.zh: 他们冲向那个男子，抓住他并将其按倒在地。

sentences.en: The pair were undercover police officers tasked with protecting Oksana.
sentences.zh: 这两人是奉命保护奥克萨娜的便衣警察。

sentences.en: The young girl shouted at the police officers,
sentences.zh: 小女孩朝着警察大喊：

sentences.en: Let Uncle Sasha go.
sentences.zh: 放开萨沙叔叔。

sentences.en: He's good.
sentences.zh: 他是好人。

sentences.en: Realising the man was known to Oksana, the officers backed off.
sentences.zh: 意识到这个男人是奥克萨娜认识的人，警察退了回去。

sentences.en: While he wasn't technically her uncle, he was a close friend of her family.
sentences.zh: 虽然他严格来说不是她的叔叔，但却是她家的挚友。

sentences.en: As a precaution, the police thoroughly looked in to Uncle Sasha.
sentences.zh: 作为预防措施，警方对萨沙叔叔进行了彻底调查。

sentences.en: They discovered that he worked at the local confectionery factory, which explained why he had candy on hand.
sentences.zh: 他们发现他在当地的糖果厂工作，这就解释了为什么他随身带着糖果。

sentences.en: A married father,
sentences.zh: 作为一名已婚父亲，

sentences.en: Uncle Sasha had received a government award for his hard work and commitment to the Soviet Union.
sentences.zh: 萨沙叔叔曾因辛勤工作和对苏联的奉献而获得政府奖项。

sentences.en: With no criminal record or anything else to highlight him as dangerous, he was ruled out as being the killer who was extorting Theodosius.
sentences.zh: 由于没有犯罪记录也没有其他任何迹象表明他很危险，他被排除在勒索狄奥多修斯的凶手之外。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile 稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持 Casefile 继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Unable to pin down a suspect, police realised that Theodosius would have to meet the killer's demands in order to flush him out.
sentences.zh: 由于无法锁定嫌疑人，警方意识到狄奥多修斯必须满足凶手的要求才能将其引诱出来。

sentences.en: Three nights after receiving the severed hand,
sentences.zh: 在收到被砍下的手掌三个晚上后，

sentences.en: Theodosius presented himself at the Kishinev train station.
sentences.zh: 狄奥多修斯出现在基希讷夫火车站。

sentences.en: He carried a briefcase containing 10,000 rubles.
sentences.zh: 他提着一个装有一万卢布的公文包。

sentences.en: The money had been hastily gathered by the Ministry of Internal Affairs to facilitate the requested handover.
sentences.zh: 这笔钱是内务部仓促凑集的，以便促成要求的交接。

sentences.en: Dozens of undercover police officers inconspicuously milled about the station, keeping a close eye on anyone who moved close to Theodosius.
sentences.zh: 数十名便衣警察在车站里毫不起眼地四处游荡，密切关注着任何靠近狄奥多修斯的人。

sentences.en: Given the second ransom letter had contained the pronoun we, police were mindful that multiple perpetrators could be involved and could also be watching the situation unfold.
sentences.zh: 鉴于第二封勒索信中包含代词“我们”，警方留心到可能有多名作案者参与，并且也可能在暗中观察事态的发展。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a lone man approached Theodosius.
sentences.zh: 突然，一个独行男子向狄奥多修斯走去。

sentences.en: The officers observed intently, waiting to make their move.
sentences.zh: 警员们全神贯注地观察着，等待采取行动。

sentences.en: The man was holding a cigarette and he asked Theodosius for a light.
sentences.zh: 那名男子叼着烟，向狄奥多修斯借个火。

sentences.en: He then continued on his way.
sentences.zh: 然后他继续往前走去。

sentences.en: He was not the man they were expecting.
sentences.zh: 他并不是他们期待的那个人。

sentences.en: Several hours passed until it became abundantly clear the exchange wasn't going to take place.
sentences.zh: 几个小时过去了，直到交易显然无法进行时，情况已经再清楚不过了。

sentences.en: Either the killer never showed up or they had realised it was a set-up.
sentences.zh: 要么是凶手根本没露面，要么是他们意识到这是一个圈套。

sentences.en: Believing they were dealing with a, quote, bloodthirsty maniac, police had to act quickly to prevent more women from being murdered and mutilated.
sentences.zh: 由于认为他们面对的是一个用他们的话说“嗜血的狂人”，警方必须迅速采取行动，以防止更多的女性被谋杀和肢解。

sentences.en: Wild rumours were spreading, with some claiming the mutilations were the act of necromancer sorcerers who were digging up graves.
sentences.zh: 各种荒诞的谣言四处流传，有人声称这些肢解行为是掘墓的招魂术士干的。

sentences.en: Others feared that an unidentified serial killer known as Metal Fang had arrived in Kishinev to continue his spree.
sentences.zh: 还有人担心一个被称为“金属獠牙”的未识别连环杀手已经来到基希讷夫继续他的犯罪狂潮。

sentences.en: Some turned their suspicions towards
sentences.zh: 有些人将怀疑的目光投向了

sentences.en: Theodosius Glukarev himself.
sentences.zh: 狄奥多西·格鲁卡雷夫本人。

sentences.en: Word was circulating that he had recently cut ties with a criminal group who were now using the extortions as a method of intimidation.
sentences.zh: 有传言称，他最近切断与一个犯罪集团的联系，而该集团现在正利用敲诈勒索作为恐吓手段。

sentences.en: With all these leads and more having reached dead ends, investigators revisited the evidence, beginning with the two extortion letters.
sentences.zh: 由于所有这些线索以及其他线索都陷入了死胡同，调查人员重新审查了证据，首先从两封勒索信入手。

sentences.en: Something was niggling at one particular investigator.
sentences.zh: 有一名特定的调查人员感到有些不对劲。

sentences.en: As he agonised over each word of the letters, the realisation suddenly dawned.
sentences.zh: 当他苦苦琢磨信中的每一个字时，突然灵光一闪。

sentences.en: In both notes, the author had referred to Theodosius by his nickname, Fedos.
sentences.zh: 在两封信中，作者都用狄奥多西的昵称费多斯（Fedos）来称呼他。

sentences.en: Upon further questioning,
sentences.zh: 经过进一步询问，

sentences.en: Theodosius revealed that he didn't like his full name and would generally ask colleagues and associates to call him Fedor for short.
sentences.zh: 狄奥多西透露他不喜欢自己的全名，通常会要求同事和熟人叫他费多尔（Fedor）的简称。

sentences.en: In turn, close friends and family took to calling him Fedos.
sentences.zh: 相应地，至亲好友则开始叫他费多斯（Fedos）。

sentences.en: Realising the killer was amongst
sentences.zh: 意识到凶手就在

sentences.en: Theodosius' immediate circle, investigators narrowed down the list of suspects until just one person remained.
sentences.zh: 狄奥多西的至亲圈子内，调查人员缩小了嫌疑人名单，直到只剩下一个人。

sentences.en: A few years earlier,
sentences.zh: 几年前，

sentences.en: Dmitry Kozintsev was enjoying his wedding reception when he realised his new wife wasn't by his side.
sentences.zh: 德米特里·科津采夫正在享受他的婚礼招待会，突然发现新婚妻子不在身边。

sentences.en: He searched the venue and eventually found her in a compromising position with another man.
sentences.zh: 他在会场四处寻找，最终在一个不合时宜的场景中发现了她和另一个男人在一起。

sentences.en: The man was Dmitry's second cousin,
sentences.zh: 那个男人是德米特里的堂弟，

sentences.en: Theodosius Glukarev.
sentences.zh: 名叫狄奥多西·格鲁卡雷夫。

sentences.en: Enraged,
sentences.zh: 愤怒之下，

sentences.en: Dmitry chased Theodosius with a knife threatening to kill him.
sentences.zh: 德米特里拿着一把刀追赶狄奥多西，扬言要杀了他。

sentences.en: Other guests disarmed Dmitry and tied him down before he could inflict any injuries.
sentences.zh: 其他宾客在德米特里造成任何伤害之前缴下了他的械并将他捆绑起来。

sentences.en: As Theodosius was led from the party,
sentences.zh: 正当狄奥多西被带离派对时，

sentences.en: Dmitry shouted that he would find him and cut him.
sentences.zh: 德米特里大喊着他会找到并砍死他。

sentences.en: Investigators explored Dmitry's background and discovered that he was already on the radar of the Soviet financial police, having been suspected of the theft
sentences.zh: 调查人员深入调查了德米特里的背景，发现他早已进入苏联金融警察的视线，因涉嫌盗窃

sentences.en: and illegal sale of rare Soviet property.
sentences.zh: 以及非法出售稀有苏联财产而受到怀疑。

sentences.en: He also worked as a dining car manager for Soviet railways, which was significant given the killer had named the Kishinev train station as the extortion money drop site.
sentences.zh: 他还担任过苏联铁路的餐车经理，鉴于凶手将基希讷乌火车站指定为勒索赎金交接地点，这一点显得意味深长。

sentences.en: Undercover officers boarded Dmitry's train in order to confront him.
sentences.zh: 便衣警察登上了德米特里的列车以便与他对质。

sentences.en: One, disguised as a railway inspector, spotted Dmitry and called him by name.
sentences.zh: 其中一人伪装成铁路检查员，认出了德米特里并叫出了他的名字。

sentences.en: Sensing he was in trouble,
sentences.zh: 感觉到自己有麻烦了，

sentences.en: Dmitry jumped from the train and ran.
sentences.zh: 德米特里从火车上跳下并逃跑。

sentences.en: The chase was short-lived as Dmitry tripped over the tracks and was swiftly apprehended.
sentences.zh: 追捕并未持续多久，德米特里被铁轨绊倒，随即被捕。

sentences.en: Dmitry denied any wrongdoing, but when he learned he was under suspicion for murder and extortion, he quickly confessed to the crimes against Soviet property.
sentences.zh: 德米特里否认有任何不当行为，但当得知自己因涉嫌谋杀和勒索而受到怀疑时，他很快承认了针对苏联财产的犯罪行为。

sentences.en: He vehemently denied having anything to do with the murders.
sentences.zh: 他坚决否认自己与谋杀案有任何关系。

sentences.en: With a little bit more digging, police were able to verify that Dmitry was telling them the truth.
sentences.zh: 经过进一步的深入挖掘，警方得以证实德米特里说的是实话。

sentences.en: He was a criminal, but he was not the killer they were looking for.
sentences.zh: 他是个罪犯，但不是他们要找的凶手。

sentences.en: The sun had just set as university student
sentences.zh: 夕阳刚刚落下，大学生

sentences.en: Olga Labadeva stood alone in Kishinev's Central Park waiting for her date.
sentences.zh: 奥尔加·拉巴杰娃独自一人站在基希讷乌中央公园里等待约会对象。

sentences.en: Several months prior,
sentences.zh: 几个月前，

sentences.en: Olga had responded to a personal ad in the local newspaper and had been corresponding with the man ever since.
sentences.zh: 奥尔加回应了当地报纸上的一则征友广告，从那以后就一直与那名男子保持书信往来。

sentences.en: This was the first time they were going to meet in person.
sentences.zh: 这是他们第一次见面。

sentences.en: Olga's date soon approached, carrying a bouquet of flowers.
sentences.zh: 奥尔加的约会对象很快走近，手里拿着一束花。

sentences.en: He handed them to her and immediately apologised, saying he couldn't stay for their date as some important business had just come up.
sentences.zh: 他把花递给她，随即道歉，称自己有重要事务急需处理，无法赴约。

sentences.en: He then turned around and hurried away.
sentences.zh: 接着他转过身匆忙离开。

sentences.en: Confused,
sentences.zh: 感到困惑，

sentences.en: Olga decided to head home.
sentences.zh: 奥尔加决定回家。

sentences.en: As she walked through the park along a tree-lined path, she heard someone approaching from behind.
sentences.zh: 当她沿着公园树木成荫的小路行走时，她听到身后有人走近。

sentences.en: Olga quickened her pace.
sentences.zh: 奥尔加加快了脚步。

sentences.en: So did the person behind her.
sentences.zh: 身后的人也加快了脚步。

sentences.en: Suddenly,
sentences.zh: 突然，

sentences.en: Olga was jerked backwards and thrown to the ground.
sentences.zh: 奥尔加被向后猛地一拉，摔倒在地上。

sentences.en: A man stood over her before pulling her into some bushes nearby.
sentences.zh: 一个男人站在她上方，随后将她拖入附近的一些灌木丛中。

sentences.en: He wrapped a hand around Olga's neck and squeezed, using his other hand to hold up a knife.
sentences.zh: 他用一只手勒住奥尔加的脖子并用力收紧，另一只手举起一把刀。

sentences.en: As Olga fought for her life, the contents of her bag spilled onto the ground.
sentences.zh: 在奥尔加为生存而挣扎时，她包里的物品散落一地。

sentences.en: She grabbed the nearest item, her hairbrush, and jammed it as hard as she could into the man's groin.
sentences.zh: 她抓起最近的一件物品——她的发刷，狠狠地朝那男人的腹股沟戳去。

sentences.en: He released his grip, dropped his knife and gripped his crotch as he curled over in pain.
sentences.zh: 他松开手，丢下刀，痛苦得蜷缩起来并紧紧捂住裆部。

sentences.en: Olga scrambled to her feet.
sentences.zh: 奥尔加挣扎着站起身来。

sentences.en: As she rushed back onto the footpath, her attacker yelled out,
sentences.zh: 当她冲回人行道时，袭击者大喊道：

sentences.en: "'I will catch up with you, creature, and I will cut you into pieces.'"
sentences.zh: "‘我要抓住你这个畜生，把你碎尸万段。’"

sentences.en: Olga ran as fast as she could, right into the path of someone who had slipped away from a birthday party early to head home.
sentences.zh: 奥尔加拼命奔跑，正好撞上了一个从生日派对提前溜出来准备回家的人。

sentences.en: They took her to the police station, where the officer on duty was intrigued to learn that Olga's attacker had threatened to cut her into pieces.
sentences.zh: 他们将她送到警察局，值班警官得知奥尔加的袭击者扬言要将她碎尸万段后感到非常震惊。

sentences.en: Police across the city had been briefed about the unidentified killer who had been sending mutilated remains to Theodosius Glukarev.
sentences.zh: 全城的警察都接到了关于那个未破案凶手的简报，该凶手曾向狄奥多西·格鲁卡雷夫寄送残缺的遗体。

sentences.en: The officer was aware that in one of the notes, the perpetrator had used the phrase,
sentences.zh: 这位警官知道，在其中一封便条中，凶手曾使用过这样一句话：

sentences.en: "'We will chop your daughter to pieces.'"
sentences.zh: "‘我们要把你的女儿碎尸万段。’"

sentences.en: Believing Olga had survived an encounter with the killer, hundreds of police officers descended on Kishinev's central park to scour the area for clues.
sentences.zh: 坚信奥尔加在凶手手中死里逃生，数百名警察涌入基希讷乌中央公园，在全区搜寻线索。

sentences.en: They soon came upon a plot of freshly disturbed earth.
sentences.zh: 他们很快发现了一处新翻动过土地的区域。

sentences.en: The area was dug up, revealing a shallow grave containing the body of a young woman.
sentences.zh: 该区域被挖开，露出一个浅浅的坟墓，里面躺着一具年轻女性的尸体。

sentences.en: Her shirt was torn open, and her trousers and underwear were pulled below her knees.
sentences.zh: 她的衬衫被扯开，裤子和内裤被拉到膝盖以下。

sentences.en: There were multiple stub wounds to her chest and around her genitals.
sentences.zh: 她的胸部和生殖器周围有多个刺伤痕迹。

sentences.en: Most significantly, her head was missing.
sentences.zh: 最引人注目的是，她的头部不见了。

sentences.en: Police had just uncovered the body of Irina Thrasen.
sentences.zh: 警方刚刚发现了伊琳娜·斯拉森的尸体。

sentences.en: Now, they were absolutely certain that the same man who attacked Olga Labadeva had killed Irina, and that he had used the expansive parklands as his hunting ground.
sentences.zh: 现在，他们绝对确信袭击奥尔加·拉巴杰娃的同一个人杀害了伊琳娜，并且他一直将广阔的公园当作他的狩猎场。

sentences.en: Olga struggled to recall much about her ordeal, as it was dark and happened quickly, but something about her assailant seemed familiar.
sentences.zh: 奥尔加很难回忆起关于她遭遇的太多细节，因为当时天黑且事情发生得很快，但袭击者的某些特征让她觉得面熟。

sentences.en: She was certain it was the same man she had met for a date thirty minutes earlier.
sentences.zh: 她确信这就是她三十分钟前赴约见面的那个人。

sentences.en: Olga explained that she had been corresponding with this man for some time.
sentences.zh: 奥尔加解释说，她与这个人已经书信联系了一段时间。

sentences.en: Investigators asked if she had kept any of the letters.
sentences.zh: 调查人员询问她是否保留了任何信件。

sentences.en: Lucky for them, she had kept them all.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，她把所有的信都留着。

sentences.en: Each of the letters were handwritten and had been signed off with the sender's name,
sentences.zh: 每一封信都是手写的，并且都签上了寄件人的名字：

sentences.en: Alexander Skrinik.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大·斯克里尼克。

sentences.en: The police were stunned.
sentences.zh: 警方惊呆了。

sentences.en: They knew Skrinik.
sentences.zh: 他们认识斯克里尼克。

sentences.en: Across most
sentences.zh: 在大多数

sentences.en: Eastern European countries, the name Alexander is commonly shortened to Sasha.
sentences.zh: 东欧国家，亚历山大这个名字通常简称为萨莎（Sasha）。

sentences.en: Alexander Skrinik was Uncle Sasha, the man who had approached
sentences.zh: 亚历山大·斯克里尼克就是萨莎叔叔，也就是几周前曾带着糖果接近

sentences.en: Theodosius' daughter with candy weeks earlier.
sentences.zh: 狄奥多西女儿的那个人。

sentences.en: A background check of Skrinik had ruled him out as a suspect, but now investigators were certain he was the killer they'd been looking for.
sentences.zh: 对斯克里尼克的背景调查曾将他排除在嫌疑人之外，但现在调查人员确信他就是他们一直在寻找的凶手。

sentences.en: They just needed to find some compelling evidence to prove it.
sentences.zh: 他们只需要找到一些令人信服的证据来证明这一点。

sentences.en: No viable forensics had been found on Irina Thrasen's head or body, nor on the unidentified severed hand left at Theodosius' door.
sentences.zh: 在伊琳娜·斯拉森的头部或身体上，以及留在狄奥多西门前的未名断手上，都没有发现可行的法医证据。

sentences.en: This just left the extortion notes and the letters to Olga.
sentences.zh: 这只剩下勒索便条和给奥尔加的信件了。

sentences.en: A handwriting expert was brought in, but when he looked at the samples, he shrugged.
sentences.zh: 警方请来了一位笔迹专家，但当他查看这些样本时，却耸了耸肩。

sentences.en: The extortion notes had been printed in block capitals, whereas the letters were in Skrinik's cursive handwriting.
sentences.zh: 勒索便条是用大写印刷体打印的，而这些信件则是斯克里尼克的草书手写体。

sentences.en: It wasn't possible to conclusively compare the two.
sentences.zh: 不可能对两者进行确凿的对比。

sentences.en: Meanwhile,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，

sentences.en: Alexander Skrinik was called to attend the military registration and enlistment office.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大·斯克里尼克被传唤前往兵役登记和征兵办公室。

sentences.en: At 27 years of age,
sentences.zh: 时年27岁，

sentences.en: Skrinik was still subject to
sentences.zh: 斯克里尼克在下次生日前

sentences.en: Soviet conscription until his next birthday.
sentences.zh: 仍然受到苏联征兵制度的约束。

sentences.en: He arrived promptly at the military office and was shown into an adjacent room.
sentences.zh: 他准时到达军事办公室，并被带进一间隔壁房间。

sentences.en: He, along with about
sentences.zh: 他与大约

sentences.en: 20 other conscripts, filled in the necessary paperwork.
